*Remember to cite Maaslin2! https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1009442*
#1) Packages and Dataframe setup
```{r}
for (lib in c('tidyverse', 'janitor','BiocManager','maaslin2')) {
      if(!require(lib, quietly = TRUE))
        install.packages(lib)
      else
        suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(lib, character.only = TRUE))
}
```

#Read in the data
```{r}
data <- read_csv('feature_table_16S.csv')
metadata <- read_csv('/Users/wjames/Desktop/PhD/SFT_NDS_RvS/data/metadata_IFGvSBC.csv')
```

#Pull samples below depth threshold
```{r 1.c fiilter data}
#get the samples less than a threshold of seq count
##set min-sequence count
count_cutoff <- 4000

drop_samples <- data %>%
  select(-ASV_ID) %>% #remove ASV-ID column as it is non-numeric
  colSums() %>% #total counts per sample
  .[. < count_cutoff] %>% #filtering the named numbers by cuttoff
  names() 

data_drop <- data %>%
  select(-any_of(drop_samples), -matches("PCR|Ext")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

metadata_drop <- metadata %>%
  filter(Sample %in% colnames(data_drop)) %>% #filter metadata to samples included
  column_to_rownames(var = 'Sample')
```

#Transpose the table and get samples to rownames
```{r}
transposed_table <- t(data_drop) %>%
  row_to_names(row_number = 1, remove_row = TRUE) %>% #make ASV_IDs 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate_all(as.numeric) #coerce to numeric

rownames(transposed_table) <- rownames(metadata_drop)
```

#Run Maaslin2
```{r}
fit_out <- Maaslin2(input_data = transposed_table,
                    input_metadata = metadata_drop,
                    output = '16s_maaslin_fits',
                    fixed_effects = 'IFG_SBC',
                    random_effects = c('Watershed','Abv_Blw','Season'))
```
